comment:
Expected: The expense is PendingApproval, the task link is present, and the original record/task snapshot is captured before the race.
Actual: ✔ approval card for EXP-1030 open in the app (this page is intentionally not refreshed before the race) | snapshot before race: {"code":"EXP-1030","Status":3,"ApprovalTaskId":"101647510","taskStatus":"Unassigned","taskAction":null} | ✔ expense is PendingApproval with a linked open task
description: Open the isolated pending-approval expense EFREG023-ExternalComplete and record its Data Fabric fields, task id, and current Action Center task state.
expectedResult: The expense is PendingApproval, the task link is present, and the original record/task snapshot is captured before the race.

comment:
Expected: The Action Center task reaches its completed state and the external decision is recorded once.
Actual: uip tasks complete -> Success | task after external completion: {"Status":"Completed","Action":"Approve","CompletedTime":"2026-09-24T10:54:48.7650757Z"} | ✔ Action Center task is Completed with action Approve (external decision recorded once)
description: Complete the linked Action Center task externally with the approved decision and comment Completed externally for regression.
expectedResult: The Action Center task reaches its completed state and the external decision is recorded once.

comment:
Expected: The app returns the specific already-completed-task conflict message; it does not show a false success or raw exception.
Actual: ✔ app returns the specific already-completed-task conflict message | ✔ no false success toast | ✔ no raw exception | message: pdf Action Center Task #101647510 Above ₹25,000 policy threshold Comments ExpenseFlow could not record the approve decision in Action Center: This Action is already completed by the same user Open exp
description: Without refreshing the app state first, submit the same decision from the app approval screen.
expectedResult: The app returns the specific already-completed-task conflict message; it does not show a false success or raw exception.

comment:
Expected: The Data Fabric record has no second decision mutation or duplicate comment, the task remains completed, and no second task is created.
Actual: after conflict: {"records":1,"Status":3,"tasks":1,"taskStatus":"Completed"} | ✔ Data Fabric record has no second decision mutation or duplicate comment | ✔ task remains completed; no second task created
description: Read the expense record and related task after the conflict.
expectedResult: The Data Fabric record has no second decision mutation or duplicate comment, the task remains completed, and no second task is created.

comment:
Expected: The completed-task conflict remains accurately represented, no duplicate decision/task appears, and the original record/task identifiers remain stable.
Actual: after refresh the card is still listed in the queue | detail after refresh: EXPENSE MANAGEMENT Expense detail RM Rahul Mehta Employee Back to my expenses EXPENSE EXP-1030 EFREG023-ExternalComplete-EFQA-20260924T1400 Pending Approval Amount ₹35,000 Category Travel Date 24 Sep 2026 Employee Rahul Mehta Receipt qa-receipt.pdf Policy Abov | ✔ no duplicate decision/task; original record and task identifiers stable | ✔ known limitation observed: the record stays PendingApproval in Data Fabric because the external completion did not update it (app does not reconcile) — reported for the analyst, not asserted as expected
description: Refresh the approval/detail route and repeat the observation without submitting again.
expectedResult: The completed-task conflict remains accurately represented, no duplicate decision/task appears, and the original record/task identifiers remain stable.
